title: Vehicle Purchase Agreements Transport Schedule — Cargo Value Surcharge
content:
**Schedule.** Under Vehicle Purchase Agreements, a cargo value surcharge is added to the transfer shipping fee from the vehicle price charged on the order net of any reversal of that price.

| Vehicle price charged, net of reversal | Cargo value surcharge |
|---|---|
| $50000.00 or more (the high cargo value) | $95.00 (the high-value cargo surcharge) |
| $35000.00 or more but below $50000.00 (the mid cargo value up to the high) | $57.50 (the mid-value cargo surcharge) |
| below $35000.00 | none |

The surcharge is added to the transfer shipping fee after the carrier price has been reduced by the program's shipping fee discount and rounded half up to the cent.

**Edges (hypothetical prices).**

| Net vehicle price | Surcharge |
|---|---|
| $34999.99 | none |
| $35000.00 | $57.50 |
| $49999.99 | $57.50 |
| $50000.00 | $95.00 |

**Hypothetical illustration.** A vehicle charged at $52400.00 whose price was reversed and recharged at $48900.00 has a net vehicle price of $48900.00 and carries $57.50.
